newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish watchdog no objection to Den Danske buy.
newsitem.headline: Swedish watchdog no objection to Den Danske buy.

text.p: Sweden's competition watchdog said on Wednesday that it had no objection to Denmark's Den Danske Bank buying Sweden's Ostgota Enskilda Bank.
"The competition body will take no action against Den Danske Bank's acquisition of Ostgota Enskilda Bank," it said in a statement.
Den Danske bought a 77 percent stake in Ostgota, a provincial bank based in southern Sweden, in March by offering 50.50 crowns a share.
It also said it was willing to pay the same price for the rest of the shares in the bank as it made its surprise swoop on the Swedish banking market.
